note: HSK 1 reading rounds in the 新版HSK (2025-12) format, Mainland edition (Simplified, Mainland wording; owner's plan 2026-10-30): 第一部分 看句子配图 ×5, 第二部分 问答配对 ×5, 第三部分 选词填空 ×5, 第四部分 读句子回答问题 (3 options) ×5. Original texts. Pictures: data/reading/img/zh/<pic.f>.webp.

questions.zh: 「我很喜歡看書」：B 是坐在沙發上看書的女孩。
questions.en: "I really like reading." B is the girl reading a book on the sofa.

questions.zh: 「她在打電話」＝她正在講電話。F 是在公車站講手機的女生。
questions.en: "She is on the phone." F is the woman talking on her phone at the bus stop.

questions.zh: 「我的貓在睡覺」。C 是在椅子底下睡覺的貓。
questions.en: "My cat is sleeping." C is the cat asleep under the chair.

questions.zh: 「我想喝水」：A 是在喝水的男生。
questions.en: "I want to drink some water." A is the young man drinking water.

questions.zh: 「兒子喜歡吃米飯」。D 是拿筷子吃飯的男孩。
questions.en: "My son likes eating rice." D is the boy eating rice with chopsticks.

questions.zh: 問「你叫什麼名字？」，回答名字：「我叫王明。」
questions.en: "What's your name?" — "My name is Wang Ming."

questions.zh: 問「你幾點去學校？」，回答時間：「八點。」
questions.en: "What time do you go to school?" — "Eight o'clock."

questions.zh: 問「你是老師嗎？」，回答「不是，我是學生。」
questions.en: "Are you a teacher?" — "No, I'm a student."

questions.zh: 別人說「謝謝你！」，回答「不客氣。」
questions.en: "Thank you!" — "You're welcome."

questions.zh: 問「你媽媽在哪兒？」（你媽媽在哪裡），回答地點：「在家裡。」A「好的，謝謝！」是多出來的。
questions.en: "Where is your mother?" — "At home." A is the spare reply.

questions.zh: 說年紀用「歲」：我今年十八歲。
questions.en: Age takes 岁 (years old): I'm eighteen this year.

questions.zh: 書的量詞是「本」：這本書是我的。
questions.en: 本 is the measure word for books: this book is mine.

questions.zh: 形容詞前面加「很」：他今天很高興。
questions.en: 很 goes before an adjective: he's very happy today.

questions.zh: 「去」＋地方：我明天去北京。
questions.en: 去 + a place: I'm going to Beijing tomorrow.

questions.zh: 「開車」：我爸爸會開車。「叫」是多出來的。
questions.en: 开车 is to drive: my dad can drive. 叫 is the spare word.

items.text: 我家有三个人：爸爸、妈妈和我。

tr.en: There are three people in my family: dad, mum and me.

questions.zh: 「我家有三個人」：爸爸、媽媽和我，一共三個人。
questions.en: "There are three people in my family" — dad, mum and him.

items.text: 今天天气很冷，我不想去学校。

tr.en: It's very cold today; I don't want to go to school.

questions.zh: 「今天天氣很冷」，所以他不想去學校。
questions.en: "It's very cold today", so he doesn't want to go to school.

items.text: 我是中国人，现在在日本工作。

tr.en: I'm Chinese, and I'm working in Japan now.

questions.zh: 他是中國人，可是「現在在日本工作」。
questions.en: He is Chinese, but he "is working in Japan now".

items.text: 现在是下午三点，我们五点去看电影。

tr.en: It's three in the afternoon now; we're going to see a film at five.

questions.zh: 現在是三點，「我們五點去看電影」。
questions.en: It's three now; they "are going to see a film at five".

items.text: 王先生是医生，他的女儿是老师。

tr.en: Mr Wang is a doctor, and his daughter is a teacher.

questions.q: 王先生的女儿做什么工作？
questions.zh: 王先生是醫生，「他的女兒是老師」。
questions.en: Mr Wang is the doctor; "his daughter is a teacher".
